description_en: Queries the details of scheduled tasks. A scheduled task is a preset task that executes a specified scaling rule at a specified time to automatically scale compute resources. After you create a scheduled task, you can call the DescribeScheduledTasks operation to query its details, such as the trigger time, the total number of scheduled tasks, and the ID of the scaling group that executes the scheduled task
description_zh: 定时任务是一种预设任务，可以在指定时间执行指定的伸缩规则，实现计算资源的自动扩缩容。定时任务创建完成后，您可以调用API DescribeScheduledTasks查询定时任务的详细信息，例如，定时任务的触发时间点、定时任务总数、执行定时任务的伸缩组的ID等
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-scheduled-tasks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --scaling-group-id asg-bp1bo5tca4m56nap0000 --scheduled-actions ari:acs:ess:cn-hangzhou:14069264740000:scalingrule/asr-bp1id5rhu8edp7kd0000 --scheduled-task-ids edRtShc57WGXdt8TlPbr0000 --scheduled-task-names scheduled0000 --task-name scheduled0000 --recurrence-type Weekly --recurrence-value 1,2,3 --task-enabled true --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeScheduledTasks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scheduled task belongs
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务所属伸缩组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the scheduled tasks to return. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The Settings for the number of entries per page during paging in a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group that executes the scheduled task
parameters.help_zh: 执行定时任务的伸缩组的ID
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The scaling rules that are executed when the scheduled tasks are triggered. This parameter is valid only when scaling rules are specified for the scheduled tasks
parameters.help_zh: 仅当定时任务指定了伸缩规则时，定时任务触发时使用的伸缩规则
parameters.name: scheduled_actions

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the scheduled tasks to query
parameters.name: scheduled_task_ids

parameters.help_en: The names of the scheduled tasks to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询定时任务的名称
parameters.name: scheduled_task_names

parameters.help_en: The task name. Fuzzy match by keyword is supported
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，支持根据关键字模糊搜索
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence type of the scheduled task. Valid values: 
Daily: The scheduled task is executed once every specified number of days. 
Weekly: The scheduled task is executed on specified days of each week. 
Monthly: The scheduled task is executed on specified days of each month. 
Cron: The scheduled task is executed based on a specified cron expression
parameters.help_zh:
重复执行定时任务的类型，取值范围： 
Daily：每多少天重复执行一次定时任务。 
Weekly：每周指定几天重复执行一次定时任务。 
Monthly：每月内指定几天重复执行一次定时任务。 
Cron：按照指定的Cron表达式执行定时任务
parameters.name: recurrence_type

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence value of the scheduled task.

This parameter is valid only when RecurrenceType is set to Weekly. You can specify multiple values separated by commas (,). For example, the values for Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6
parameters.help_zh:
重复执行定时任务的数值。

仅支持当RecurrenceType为Weekly时指定此字段，可以填入多个值，填多个值时使用半角逗号（,）分隔。例如，周日、周一、周二、周三、周四、周五、周六的值依次为：0,1,2,3,4,5,6
parameters.name: recurrence_value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the scheduled task is started. Valid values:
true: The task is started.
false: The task is stopped
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务是否已启动。
true：任务已启动。
false：任务已停止
parameters.name: task_enabled

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

ScheduledTasks.description_zh: 定时任务信息组成的集合

items.description_zh: 定时任务信息组成的集合

Description.description_en: The description of the scheduled task

DesiredCapacity.description_en: The expected number of instances in the scaling group. This parameter is returned when the scaling method of the scheduled task is set to adjust the number of instances in the scaling group
DesiredCapacity.description_zh: 定时任务的`伸缩方式`选择`伸缩组内实例数量设置`时，指定伸缩组内实例的期望实例数

LaunchExpirationTime.description_en: The retry period after the scheduled task fails to be triggered. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 21600
LaunchExpirationTime.description_zh: 定时任务触发操作失败后，在此时间内重试。单位为秒，取值范围：0~21600

LaunchTime.description_en: The time when the scheduled task is triggered. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ format
LaunchTime.description_zh: 定时任务触发的时间点，采用ISO 8601标准的UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

MaxValue.description_en: The maximum number of instances in the scaling group. This parameter is returned when the scaling method of the scheduled task is set to adjust the number of instances in the scaling group
MaxValue.description_zh: 定时任务的`伸缩方式`选择`伸缩组内实例数量设置`时，指定伸缩组内实例的最大数量

MinValue.description_en: The minimum number of instances in the scaling group. This parameter is returned when the scaling method of the scheduled task is set to adjust the number of instances in the scaling group
MinValue.description_zh: 定时任务的`伸缩方式`选择`伸缩组内实例数量设置`时，指定伸缩组内实例的最小数量

RecurrenceEndTime.description_en: The end time of the recurrence for triggering the scheduled task. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ format
RecurrenceEndTime.description_zh: 重复触发定时任务的结束时间，采用ISO 8601标准的UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

RecurrenceType.description_en: The recurrence type for triggering the scheduled task
RecurrenceType.description_zh: 重复触发定时任务的类型

RecurrenceValue.description_en: The recurrence value for triggering the scheduled task
RecurrenceValue.description_zh: 重复触发定时任务的数值

ScalingGroupId.description_en: The ID of the scaling group that executes the scheduled task
ScalingGroupId.description_zh: 执行定时任务的伸缩组的ID

ScheduledAction.description_en: The scaling rule executed when the scheduled task is triggered. This parameter is returned only when a scaling rule is specified for the scheduled task
ScheduledAction.description_zh: 执行定时任务时使用的伸缩规则。仅当定时任务指定了伸缩规则时，返回该参数

ScheduledTaskId.description_en: The ID of the scheduled task

ScheduledTaskName.description_en: The name of the scheduled task

TaskEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the scheduled task is started. Valid values: 
true: The task is started.
false: The task is stopped.

Default value: true
TaskEnabled.description_zh:
是否启动定时任务。 
true：启动任务。
false：停止任务 。

默认值：true

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of scheduled tasks
